{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor hitch''' was a device that, through the use of a small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] encased in a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] shell, could lift items up to 200 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], allowing them to be moved without a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].
